title: Secure Cloud Hosting and CUI Data Management
naics_text: Primary NAICS 518210 - Data Processing, Hosting, and Related Services
description: 8(a) set-aside. Contractor must safeguard Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) in accordance with DFARS 252.204-7012 and implement NIST SP 800-171 controls, with the hosting environment meeting NIST SP 800-53 and FedRAMP Moderate authorization. A current System Security Plan (SSP) and Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) are required at award. Items subject to ITAR must be handled by U.S. persons only. Available under GSA SIN 518210C.
notes: FISMA compliance applies to all hosted systems.
